ambient_events: Somebody stops on the kerb to retie a shoe.
A street sweeper goes by on Sorrel Way with its brushes up.
A sparrow lands on the kerb, finds nothing and goes.
description: A kept corner where Windrow Lane meets Kettle Lane: a stone-kerbed flowerbed, a clipped hedge and an urn. The back of 25 Hughson Way stands over it.
name: Windrow Corner
